title: Computer-Aided Modelling of the Bilingual Word Indices to the Ninth-Century Uchitel’noe evangelie
reasoning: The paper describes a technical and philological approach to creating bilingual word indices for a 9th-century religious text. While the subject matter of the corpus is religious, the research objective is focused on corpus linguistics, translation modeling, and software tools for philologists, not on evaluating or benchmarking religious values, ethics, or moral reasoning.
